sub-flow.name: start-request-context
sub-flow.doc:description: Captures the correlation ID and start time and logs the incoming request

ee:transform.doc:name: Capture request context
ee:transform.doc:description: Stores the correlation ID and request start time in variables

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var incoming = attributes.headers['x-correlation-id'] --- if (isBlank(incoming)) correlationId else incoming
%dw 2.0 output application/java --- now() as Number { unit: "milliseconds" }

logger.doc:name: Log request received
logger.doc:description: Logs method and path of the incoming request

sub-flow.name: log-response-sent
sub-flow.doc:description: Logs the response status and the request duration

logger.message: #['Response sent status=$(vars.httpStatus default 200) durationMs=$((now() as Number { unit: 'milliseconds' }) - (vars.requestStartMillis default 0))']
logger.doc:name: Log response sent
logger.doc:description: Logs status and duration of a successful request
